uncovered_features.feature_name: admin-groups flag in create and update APIs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The create and update APIs now support an admin-groups flag to designate cluster administrator groups without manual RBAC policy application.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Node auto repair
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Node auto repair is added to continuously monitor node health in each node pool; Node auto repair is available in preview, enabling continuous monitoring of node health in node pools.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Control plane metrics export
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Monitoring is improved by exporting metrics for control-plane components.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes resource metadata export to Google Cloud
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes resource metadata can be sent to Google Cloud Platform for improved UI and cluster metrics, requiring the Config Monitoring for Ops API.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Per-node-pool subnet security group ingress
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Control-plane ingress is restricted to node-pool subnet IP ranges on TCP 443 and 8123 instead of VPC-wide rules.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Ubuntu 22.04 OS image
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos on AWS node pools can use Ubuntu 22.04 as the default OS image.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Supported Kubernetes versions
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now support launching with Kubernetes versions 1.23.16-gke.2800, 1.24.10-gke.1200, and 1.25.6-gke.1600; Anthos clusters on AWS now support launching with Kubernetes versions 1.23.16-gke.200, 1.24.9-gke.2000, and 1.25.5-gke.2000.

uncovered_features.feature_name: containerd runtime upgrade
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The containerd container runtime is upgraded to version 1.6.12.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Cloud Monitoring control plane metrics ingestion for Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Google Cloud Monitoring now ingests control-plane metrics from kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager, and etcd as a preview feature.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Dynamic AWS node pool tag updates
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now support dynamically updating AWS node pool tags via required autoscaling and EC2 permissions.

uncovered_features.feature_name: gke-token-manager
uncovered_features.feature_summary: A new gke-token-manager component was added to generate tokens for control-plane components.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Google Group-based RBAC access for Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Administrators can grant AWS cluster access to all members of a Google Group by assigning the required RBAC permission to that group.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.22 support removal
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes 1.22 versions are no longer supported for Anthos clusters on AWS; deprecated on 2022-12-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes v1.25 API deprecations
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes 1.25 in Anthos clusters on AWS deprecates several Kubernetes APIs; deprecated on 2022-12-15.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Managed Service for Prometheus workload metrics ingest to Cloud Monarch
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Workload metrics can be uploaded to Cloud Monarch using managed collection in Google Managed Service for Prometheus, with this capability upgraded to GA.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Arm node pools in Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Creating Arm architecture node pools is now available as a preview feature in Anthos clusters on AWS.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Cloud Console management for Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS can now be updated, upgraded, and deleted through the Google Cloud console.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Cloud Monitoring support for Windows node pools in Anthos on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos clusters on AWS now support Cloud Monitoring for Windows node pools starting in Kubernetes version 1.24 and later.
keywords: Cloud Monitoring for Windows node pools

uncovered_features.feature_name: Control plane tag updates on Kubernetes 1.24+ clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos Clusters on AWS now supports updating control plane tags for Kubernetes clusters running version 1.24 or later.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus availability
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus became available as an invite-only private preview on Anthos clusters on AWS for managed Prometheus-based monitoring and alerting.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.21 support in Anthos clusters on AWS
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos Clusters on AWS no longer supports Kubernetes 1.21 versions; deprecated on 2022-09-29.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Cloud Audit Logs for clusters
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Cluster Cloud Audit Logs became available and enabled by default for Kubernetes 1.23 and higher clusters.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Disable profiling endpoint by default
uncovered_features.feature_summary: In Kubernetes 1.23.7-gke.1300, the profiling endpoint (/debug/pprof) is disabled by default in kube-scheduler and kube-controller-manager.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Instance Metadata Service emulator
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes 1.23.7-gke.1300 added an Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) emulator.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.23 cluster launch support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos on AWS added the ability to launch Kubernetes 1.23 clusters.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Strong cryptographic ciphers for control plane components
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes 1.23.7-gke.1300 updated kube-apiserver and kubelet to use only strong cryptographic ciphers.

uncovered_features.feature_name: VolumeSnapshot v1beta1 API deprecation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: A future 1.23 release is slated to stop serving VolumeSnapshot v1beta1 APIs, with migration to VolumeSnapshot v1 recommended; deprecated on 2022-07-13.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Asynchronous boot error visibility in long-running operations
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Most common asynchronous cluster and nodepool boot errors can now be viewed in the long-running operation error field.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Custom logging parameters on cluster creation
uncovered_features.feature_summary: New Kubernetes 1.22 clusters can now be configured with custom logging parameters at creation time.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Dedicated host node pools (preview)
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Anthos on AWS added a preview capability to configure nodes to run on dedicated hosts.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Expanded cluster and node pool configuration updates
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Cluster updates now support more configuration fields, including control plane security group IDs, proxy settings, node pool SSH settings, root volume, and encryption settings.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Kubernetes 1.22 deprecated v1beta1 API removals
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Kubernetes 1.22 removes support for several deprecated v1beta1 APIs and requires workloads to migrate to stable v1 APIs; deprecated on 2022-04-13.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Windows node pool image type preview
uncovered_features.feature_summary: A preview feature allows selecting Windows as the node pool image type when creating node pools on Kubernetes 1.22.8.
keywords: create node pool with Windows image
